newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down as investors book profit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down as investors book profit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down as most shares and many of the blue chips fell on profit-taking by small investors, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index lost 63.93 points or 3.46 percent at 1,782.36 on a turnover of 126.8 million taka. Of 112 traded issues 21 gained, 86 lost and five unchanged. "The index fell mainly because of the losses by weighted shares, but the market was quite active," said one broker.
Leasing Company IDLC lost 457 taka to 4,905, Beximco Pharma lost 7.0 to 220 and Chittagong Cement was down 574 to 5,422.
